summary: 31 units reviewed (8.1.33-63), 13 flagged. Errors: 7 (unsupported additions: '— so ends the view' in 40 and 52, English and Hindi; 'only'/'its own' in 59, English and Hindi, plus the 52 'graver'). Minor: 14 (garīyaḥ rendering 'more serious' with the supplied predicate in brackets in 33/41/53, following chunk 1 and p08/ch03; gender labels in 36 and 57; piṇḍayitum stem in 44; 'even'/'भी' in 56; alternative readings recorded in notes for 42 and 58; 62 needs a person). Tokens, splits and sandhi match the e-text throughout; the 41 compound-dot note is right. No regrouping suggested. Glossary extended with vyasana, garīyas, the 'No, says X' formula, kupya, āṭavika/aṭavī, upajāpa and the handling of a closing iti.
